search_files.desc: Find files and directories by NAME using glob patterns or Go regex (use_regex=true). Use when you know all or part of a filename/path but not its location. Returns concise relative paths by default. Patterns without / match basenames; patterns with / or ** match relative paths. For file CONTENTS, use grep_files instead.

params.path: Root directory to search from. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.max_results: Maximum results to return. Default: 100. Narrow with pattern/exclude_patterns before raising this.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression instead of a glob. If the regex contains no /, it is matched against each basename; otherwise it is matched against the relative path. Default: false.
params.case_insensitive: Case-insensitive name matching for glob or regex mode. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each entry's basename (not full path). Matching directories are pruned. Use to skip node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, or generated files.
params.output_mode: "paths" (default) returns one path per line. "details" includes type, size, and modification time.
params.path_format: "relative" (default) returns paths relative to the search root. "absolute" returns absolute paths.
params.entry_type: "any" (default), "file", or "dir". Filter matches by filesystem entry type.

grep_files.desc: Search file CONTENTS for a pattern. Use for code/content search; use search_files for names. Relative paths are returned by default. output_mode="auto" shows matching lines when results fit, then falls back to a file list when capped. Supports literal or Go regex search, context lines, pagination via offset, glob/exclude filtering, multiline mode, and max_file_size for large/generated/data files.

params.path: File or directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.pattern: Literal text or regular expression to search for. Required.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Required for | (alternation), . (wildcard), +, *, ^, $, and character classes (\w, \d). Default: false.
params.context_lines: Lines before and after each match to include. Default: 0. Max: 50.
params.max_results: Max matches per page (content mode). Default: 50.
params.offset: Skip the first N matches for pagination. Default: 0.
params.glob: Only search files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go, *.{ts,tsx}). Strongly prefer setting this in large projects. Default: all files.
params.output_mode: "auto" (default) — adapts based on result count. "content" — always show matching lines. "files_with_matches" — only file paths. "count" — match counts per file.
params.multiline: Enable patterns that span multiple lines. Default: false.
params.max_file_size: Skip files larger than this many bytes. Default: 0 (no limit). Set this when searching large repos with logs, exports, databases, or generated files.
params.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each entry's basename (not full path). Matching directories are pruned before searching. Use to skip node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, or generated files.
params.path_format: "relative" (default) returns paths relative to the search root. "absolute" returns absolute paths.
